title: Anton Poletaev
content: Anton has more than 10 years’ experience in the field of investment banking. Prior to joining RB Partners, he held leading positions in RB Invest, Althaus Capital and Uralsib Capital. Anton graduated from the Higher School of Economics with a master’s degree in Economics. Anton is in charge of M&A projects.

title: Alexander Lukin
content: Alexander has more than 25 years’ experience in financial and industrial sectors. Prior to joining RB Partners, he held positions of Deputy Director in Basic Element, Financial Director in Deutsche UFG, Member of Executive Board in Gazprom Media and leading positions in the Sputnik Group and NTV Plus. Alexander graduated from Lomonosov Moscow State University, he is a member of the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA), Great Britain, and he has the professional qualification of Chartered Director in the field of corporate finance. Alexander is in charge of M&A projects.

title: Konstantin Dzhimbinov
content: Konstantin has more than 25 years of experience in the banking and financial advisory sectors. Prior to establishing the RB Partners Group, Konstantin was Vice President of VTB Bank and Head of MIS in Alfa-Bank. From 1996 to 2000, as a Manager at PwC (Moscow), he headed projects providing financial advisory services to large Russian and international banks and companies (Central Bank of Russia, Sberbank, MDM Bank, Chase Manhattan International, MICEX and others). Konstantin is an independent member of the Board of Directors in Orient Express Bank since June 2010 and he was elected Chairman of the Board of Directors in Orient Express Bank in April 2015. Konstantin graduated with honours from the Financial Academy of the Russian Government. He is a Ph.D (Economics) and a lecturer of the Skolkovo Moscow School of Management. Konstantin is in charge of M&A transactions support.

title: Stephen Price
content: Stephen has more than 40 years of experience in the financial advisory sector. His career includes projects for the World Bank, the International Monetary Fund and the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development. Prior to establishing the RB Partners Group, Stephen was a Senior Partner at EY (UK). In the mid 90s, while at EY, he organized an international group providing corporate finance services to financial institutions operating in the emerging markets. Stephen graduated with honours from Leeds University (UK) and is a Fellow of the Institute of Chartered Accountants in England & Wales. Stephen is responsible for cooperation with the international counterparties of the RB Partners Group.

title: Arseniy Dabbakh
content:
Arseniy has more then 20 years of experience in sales, marketing and finance. Prior to joining RB Partners as a Partner,he was a Co-Founder and a Managing Partner of RMG Partners (2014-2016). He began his career in IT sector in 3M Co. in 1995. Between 1997-2003 he worked in sales & marketing in various tech companies Duracell, Digitex Europe, etc. In 2005-2010, he was a Co-Founder and Managing Partner of invest boutique Gurus Capital, focused on M&A cross border transactions in MidCap. Then between 2010-2014 he worked in investment bank RMG, as Corporate Finance Director and Head of investments. 
Education: RUDN University, MBA California State University, Skolkovo PE/VC. Investor & board member of several tech startups. Board member and Head of VC Committee of National Alternative Investments Managers Association  (www.naima-russia.org). Arseniy is in charge of transaction support with hi-tech companies and VC market analysis.

title: Alexander Lukin
content:
Alexander has more than 25 years’ experience in the financial and industrial sectors. Prior to joining RB Partners, he held the positions of Deputy Director in Basic Element, Financial Director in Deutsche UFG, Member of Executive Board in Gazprom Media and leading positions in the Sputnik Group and NTV Plus. Alexander worked is a member of the Board of Directors in
the company Element Leasing. Alexander graduated from Lomonosov Moscow State University, he is a member of the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA), Great Britain, and he has the professional qualification of Chartered Director in the field of corporate finance. title: Konstantin Dzhimbinov
content: Konstantin is a co-founder of the RB Partners Group and has more than 25 years of experience in the banking and financial advisory sectors. Prior to establishing RB Partners, Konstantin was Vice President of VTB Bank and Head of MIS in Alfa-Bank. From 1996 to 2000, as a Manager at PwC (Moscow), he headed projects providing financial advisory services to large Russian and international banks and companies (Central Bank of Russia, Sberbank, MDM Bank, Chase Manhattan International, Moscow Exchange and others). Konstatin is a  member of the Expert Board of the Moscow Exchange. Konstantin graduated with honours from the Financial Academy of the Russian Government. He is a Ph.D (Economics) and a visiting lecturer of the Skolkovo Moscow School of Management. Konstantin is in charge of the general coordination of the Group's activity.

title: Alexey Goryachev
content: Alexey has more than 25 years of experience in investments and financial advisory services. Prior to joining RB Partners as a Senior Partner, he was a Co-Founder and a Managing Partner of RMG Partners (2014-2016). He began his career as an economist in the State Statistical Committee of the Russian Federation in 1989. Between 1990-1991 he was the chief expert of the stock department of the first Russian stock exchange, in 1991-1992 a co-founder and director of one of the first Russian investment companies «Shares of Russia», in 1992-1994 a manager of the National Investment Fund, 1994 -2014 a Co-founder, President, Chairman of the Board of Directors in RMG Partners. Education: Financial Academy of the Russian Government, MBA Kennedy Western University, Executive MBA Skolkovo, Berkeley HAAS, Harvard Business School. YPO (Young Presidents Organization) Moscow Chapter Chair, Master of Business, EY Entrepreneur of the Year 2015. Alex is in charge of M&A transactions support.

title: Alexander Idrisov
content:
Alexander is a non executive director, Chairman of the Board of Directors of RB Partners Group and one of the leading experts on Strategy and corporate finance in Russia. In the early 2000s, he was elected President of the National Guild of Investment and Financial Analysts (GIFA) and represented the Russian Federation in the European Federation of Financial Analysts Societies (EFFAS) and the Global Association of Certified International Investment Analysts (ACIIA). 

Alexander is the founder of Strategy Partners Group, a Russian leading Strategy Advisory Firm, providing consulting service for the benefit of corporate and public clients in various sectors of the economy.

Alexander is a co-founder of Think Tank - Eurasia Competitiveness Institute (Belgium) that is a coordinator of WEF programs in Russia and represents Russia in the Global Federation of Competitiveness Councils (GFCC), which unites more than 35 countries from the USA to Japan.

Currently, Alexander is a member of the Boards of Directors of several leading companies in the following sectors of the economy: Construction and Engineering, FMCG, Digital and AI Solutions, Fishing Industry and Forestry.

As an angel investor, Alexander has been investing in startups for many years.

Alexander teaches at the Skolkovo Business School as a Visiting Professor. 

He has graduated from the post-graduate studies under the Moscow State Technical University named after Bauman. Further education:  General Management (Deutsche Management Akademie), Banking & Finance (Deutsches Institute fur Betriebswirschift), Management Professional Service Firm (HBS), Board management (IMD).
